id: 07_Fundamentals of Laboratory Safety Emergency Procedures and Reporting Scenario
title: 手套破了，要不要说
source_doc: course/CDC Laboratory Safety Series/07_Fundamentals of Laboratory Safety Emergency Procedures and Reporting Scenario.md
author_source: project/CDC Laboratory Safety Series/07_Fundamentals of Laboratory Safety Emergency Procedures and Reporting Scenario/src.py

points.K1: 针头刺破手套，皮肤没伤
points.K2: 这样的未遂要不要报告
points.K3: 本课不能代替本实验室规程
points.S3: 逐级报告：负责人、学院、学校

shots.scene: 欣欣举着一只有小破洞的手套，向镜头歪头
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot holds up a blue nitrile glove with a tiny hole and tilts its head at the camera.
shots.narration: 这一课：手套破了，要不要告诉别人？

shots.scene: 阿杰戴蓝手套，在生物安全柜前做实验
shots.prompt_en: The young male student in a lab coat, goggles and blue nitrile gloves works at a biological safety cabinet.
shots.narration: 阿杰正在生物安全柜里做实验。

shots.section_title: 针头刺破手套，皮肤没伤
shots.scene: 针头图标擦过手套图标，手套上出现一个小破口
shots.prompt_en: An icon of a needle tip grazing a gloved finger, leaving a tiny tear in the glove. No people.
shots.narration: 一不小心，针头刺破了手套。
overlay: 针头刺破手套，皮肤没伤

shots.section_title: 针头刺破手套，皮肤没伤
shots.scene: 阿杰看看手指，松了口气
shots.prompt_en: The young male student looks at his gloved finger and lets out a sigh of relief.
shots.narration: 还好，好像没扎到皮肤。

shots.section_title: 这样的未遂要不要报告
shots.scene: 阿杰把手指藏到身后，想当作没发生
shots.prompt_en: The young male student hides his hand behind his back and looks around, pretending nothing happened.
shots.narration: 没受伤，要不要告诉别人？
overlay: 这样的未遂要不要报告

shots.section_title: 这样的未遂要不要报告
shots.scene: 欣欣从旁边探出头，用力点头
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot pops out from the side and nods firmly.
shots.narration: 答案是：要说，而且要马上说。

shots.scene: 阿杰把注射器放进锐器盒，双手离开操作区
shots.prompt_en: The young male student places the syringe into a sharps container and steps his hands back from the work area.
shots.narration: 先停下，把锐器安全放好。

shots.scene: 阿杰脱下手套，对着灯光仔细看手指
shots.prompt_en: The young male student removes his gloves and carefully inspects his finger under the light.
shots.narration: 脱下手套，仔细检查皮肤有没有伤口。

shots.scene: 阿杰在水槽边洗手，然后戴上新手套
shots.prompt_en: The young male student washes his hands at a sink and then puts on a fresh pair of gloves.
shots.narration: 洗手，换上新手套。

shots.scene: 手指图标上有红点，箭头指向冲洗和医院图标
shots.prompt_en: A finger icon with a small red dot, with arrows pointing to a running faucet icon and a hospital icon. No people.
shots.narration: 一旦发现破皮，就按暴露处置。

shots.scene: 冰山图标：水面上一小块，水面下一大块
shots.prompt_en: An iceberg icon with a small tip above the water line and a much larger part below. No people.
shots.narration: 未遂事件，是水面下的冰山。

shots.scene: 针头朝向自己的图标被红叉划掉
shots.prompt_en: An icon of a needle pointing toward the user's own hand, crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 这次没伤到，下次可能就扎进去。

shots.scene: 小研和阿杰一起看着空白流程图，找出问题环节
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student and the young male student look at a blank flow chart and circle one step.
shots.narration: 说出来，大家才能找到原因、改掉它。

shots.scene: 举手的小人图标旁是盾牌
shots.prompt_en: A person pictogram raising a hand, next to a shield icon. No people.
shots.narration: 报告不是挨批评，是保护大家。

shots.section_title: 逐级报告：负责人、学院、学校
shots.scene: 阿杰走进老周办公室，比划刚才的情况
shots.prompt_en: The young male student walks into the older man's office and explains what happened with gestures.
shots.narration: 第一时间报告实验室负责人。
overlay: 逐级报告：负责人、学院、学校

shots.section_title: 逐级报告：负责人、学院、学校
shots.scene: 三层台阶图标：实验室、学院、学校，箭头向上
shots.prompt_en: A three-level step icon with upward arrows: a lab room, a school building, and a university building. No people.
shots.narration: 需要时，再报学院和学校管理部门。

shots.section_title: 逐级报告：负责人、学院、学校
shots.scene: 王老师在空白登记表上记录
shots.prompt_en: The safety administrator writes the details on a blank incident report form.
shots.narration: 如实登记时间、经过和处理情况。

shots.scene: 实验室门边张贴着应急电话卡，只有电话图标和数字
shots.prompt_en: An emergency contact card on the wall by the lab door, showing phone icons and large digits only. No people.
shots.narration: 门口张贴的应急电话，要记牢。

shots.scene: 火焰图标旁是电话和119
shots.prompt_en: A flame icon next to a telephone icon. No people.
shots.narration: 着火爆炸，拨打119。

shots.scene: 红十字图标旁是电话和120
shots.prompt_en: A red cross icon next to a telephone icon. No people.
shots.narration: 有人受伤，拨打120。

shots.scene: 保卫处值班员接起电话，迅速记录
shots.prompt_en: The security officer answers the phone at the duty desk and quickly takes notes.
shots.narration: 同时通知学校保卫处，引导救援。

shots.scene: 老周把一本空白的应急预案放到架子上
shots.prompt_en: The older man places a blank emergency plan binder on the shelf near the lab door.
shots.narration: 实验室要有应急预案，人人知道。

shots.scene: 全组人员在王老师带领下练习疏散和使用洗眼器
shots.prompt_en: Led by the safety administrator, the team practices an evacuation drill and using an eyewash station.
shots.narration: 定期演练，出事时才不慌。

shots.section_title: 本课不能代替本实验室规程
shots.scene: 一张空白课程卡片和一本更大的空白规程手册
shots.prompt_en: A small blank course card next to a larger blank procedure binder with a check mark. No people.
shots.narration: 这门课不能代替本实验室的规程。
overlay: 本课不能代替本实验室规程

shots.scene: 欣欣身旁浮现破手套、锐器盒、洗手图标
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot stands beside floating icons of a torn glove, a sharps container and hand washing.
shots.narration: 停下操作，查皮肤，换手套。

shots.scene: 冰山和三层台阶图标
shots.prompt_en: Icons of an iceberg and a three-level step with upward arrows. No people.
shots.narration: 未遂也报告，负责人、学院、学校。

shots.scene: 119、120和保卫处三个电话图标
shots.prompt_en: Three telephone icons side by side. No people.
shots.narration: 紧急情况，119、120、保卫处。

shots.scene: 欣欣和阿杰在应急电话卡前挥手
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot and the young male student wave goodbye in front of the emergency contact card by the lab door.
shots.narration: 说出来，就是保护大家，下次见！
